build_get_marketplace: build a FastAPI endpoint that serves marketplace.json listing all enabled Claude Code plugins with git sources
create_register_plugin: create a POST endpoint to register a new Claude Code plugin with name, source, and metadata in the LiteLLM database
list_plugins: list all registered Claude Code plugins with optional enabled-only filter and sorted by creation date
manage_enable_plugin: enable a previously disabled Claude Code plugin by name via the LiteLLM proxy API
manage_disable_plugin: disable a Claude Code plugin by name without deleting its metadata from the LiteLLM database
